notes: §1985:XIII.3.21.2 prints '[ USAGE IS ] DISPLAY', and 'The USAGE clause for a report group item can specify only USAGE IS DISPLAY' (§1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR3). The shared usageClause parses every usage; ReportSectionBinder.ScreenReportUsage refuses any usage but DISPLAY or NATIONAL in a report entry (COBOL2198, the witness's COMPUTATIONAL), at the clause and at the settled usage, and VersionConformancePass.GateData walks each report printable item through UsageConstructId so USAGE NATIONAL / PIC N is refused at 85 as NationalData2002 (COBOL0900). Probes at 85: USAGE IS DISPLAY, USAGE DISPLAY and bare DISPLAY print '007', group-level USAGE DISPLAY with subordinate DISPLAY prints '-012 ****'; COMP, BINARY, PACKED-DECIMAL, INDEX and a group USAGE COMP COBOL2198; USAGE NATIONAL with PIC N(3) COBOL0900 (accepted at 2023, 'ABC'), with PIC X(3) COBOL0881; USAGE twice COBOL2423, USAGE IS alone a parse error; NATIONAL (a user word at 85) accepted as an entry name. COBOL2198's text names DISPLAY or NATIONAL at 85 as well, a wording point only.

next.reason: 1985 report-writer USAGE is '[USAGE IS] DISPLAY' only (§1985:XIII.3.21.3 SR3). §2023:13.15.2 gives '[USAGE IS] {DISPLAY|NATIONAL}' and §2023:13.18.60.3 SR7 'Only the DISPLAY or NATIONAL phrase may be specified in any USAGE clause associated with a report group item', the clause otherwise being the general USAGE clause of §2023:13.18.60.2 (§2023:13.15.4 GR2). USAGE NATIONAL in a report group, refused in 1985, is accepted. CHANGED (looser).
